summary: Sense forks batch 3 (#1233 B; docs/notes/load-bearing-terms.md), each sense its own Lean declaration and one argument per sense. Maxime ens at the root-route node STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-CAUSES-ALL-BEINGS: MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-CAUSES-ALL-AS-MAXIMAL (instantiation), the existing MAXIMAL-BEING-CAUSES-FROM-GREATEST-DEGREE (MAXIME_2) and MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-CAUSES-ALL-AS-STRICTLY-GREATEST through a maximal-to-strict bridge derived from connectedness of more-in, shown needed by a tied-maxima model. Existence layer, at the quarta via's conclusion STMT-MAXIME-ENS-CAUSES-BEING-OF-ALL (which no root argument consumes): MAXIME-ENS-CAUSES-ALL-AS-MAXIMAL, -AS-GREATEST-DEGREE and -AS-STRICTLY-GREATEST; the last two reach the MAXIMAL root node only through explicit sense bridges, each derived (degree tracking; asymmetry of more-in) and each shown needed by an omission model. The mixed reading (existence MAXIMAL, causal GREATEST-degree) fails in the incomparable-degree model; tied maxima separate MAXIME_1 from MAXIME_3 existence. Potency to STMT-NOTHING-MOVES-ITSELF-IN-SAME-RESPECT: ADOPTED needs no non-simultaneity premise (one premise fewer than the INDEPENDENT route AQUINAS-NO-SELF-MOTION-SAME-RESPECT); CAPACITY is valid but its non-simultaneity premise is refuted under an exercised capacity, which both Aristotle's builder and the Megarian thesis (with some capacity) supply; the mixed reading (moved CAPACITY, non-simultaneity ADOPTED) allows self-motion. Rejected leads: (1) an Anselmian constructor for maxime ens (conceptual description, no Lean declaration, no root use; a rival reading denies coverage); (2) reusing MaximumDefinitionFork.NamedCoverage, whose Frame is the calibration profile's declaration and would put a further sense's declaration into every per-sense theorem; (3) a Megarian constructor for potency (a thesis on the capacity relation, used as a premise instead); (4) forking DISAMB-PER-SE (homonyms: two senses already have distinct Lean types, two are epistemic statuses with no declaration, no root use admits two senses); (5) forking DISAMB-RECEPTIVE-POTENCY (receptive potency is a principle-to-act relation, a different Lean type from InPotency, so equivocation is already a type error). (6) first targeting STMT-MAXIME-ENS-CAUSES-BEING-OF-ALL as the root-route node: it is not consumed by any argument reaching the root, so the per-sense layer was added at STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-CAUSES-ALL-BEINGS.
blocker: Coverage and exclusivity of both forks are OPEN frontier premises. The maxime-ens sense bridges rest on the OPEN STMT-MORE-IN-BEING-CONNECTED (a total scale of being, which analogical being denies), the OPEN STMT-MORE-IN-BEING-TRACKS-DEGREE and STMT-MORE-IN-IS-ASYMMETRIC. STMT-MOVED-ONLY-AS-IN-ADOPTED-POTENCY is open; STMT-SOME-CAPACITY-EXERCISED is open. DISAMB-POTENCY-IN-SUBJECT-VS-IN-ANOTHER was not reached: DEF-MUTABLE-THROUGH-ANOTHER has no Lean declaration (needs: a typed power-in-another relation over beings and respects).
